name: Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park
policyReason: Leashed dogs may walk the Rim Rock and Chasm View Nature trails, overlooks, campgrounds and roads.
summary: Leashed dogs may walk the Rim Rock and Chasm View Nature trails, overlooks, campgrounds and roads.

excerpts.quote: Leashed dogs are permitted on the Rim Rock Trail, Chasm View Nature Trail, picnic areas, campgrounds, parking lots, and paths to overlooks.

dogRules.text: Only the Rim Rock Trail and the North Rim Chasm View Nature Trail allow pets.
No pets on other trails, inner canyon routes, wilderness, or ski and snowshoe trails.
Allowed in picnic areas, campgrounds, parking lots, overlook paths and open roads.
